{
  "subtype": "faceted_decomposition",
  "concept": "declined_expense_reasons",
  "per_column": [
    {
      "name": "asset_category",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "Describes what kind of asset the expense concerns, not a reason or compliance risk for the decline. It is an attribute of the expense that may correlate with declines, not an aspect OF the decline reason itself."
    },
    {
      "name": "entry_origin",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "Whether the entry was manual or auto-generated is a provenance attribute that could predict data-quality declines, but it is not itself a constituent aspect of the decline reason."
    },
    {
      "name": "asset_lifecycle_action",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "Captures the lifecycle stage/action of the asset, an attribute of the expense context rather than a facet of why it was declined or what compliance risk applies."
    },
    {
      "name": "source_id_present",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "A data-completeness flag on a source identifier. At best a predictor/symptom of a possible compliance/data issue, not a constitutive part of the decline-reason concept."
    },
    {
      "name": "ci_id_quality",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "Quality classification of the CI identifier; a data-quality attribute that may drive declines but does not decompose the reason concept into its aspects."
    },
    {
      "name": "travel_related",
      "is_constitutive_facet": false,
      "role": "external_predictor",
      "rationale": "A flag on whether the expense is travel-related, an attribute of the expense subject matter, not an aspect of the decline reason or its compliance-risk dimensions."
    }
  ],
  "facet_columns": [],
  "non_facet_columns": [
    "asset_category",
    "entry_origin",
    "asset_lifecycle_action",
    "source_id_present",
    "ci_id_quality",
    "travel_related"
  ],
  "mutual_exclusivity": 0.0,
  "exhaustiveness": 0.0,
  "rationale": "None of the added columns are constitutive facets (parts) of 'declined_expense_reasons'. A proper faceted decomposition would carve the decline-reason concept into aspects such as reason category (policy violation, missing documentation, budget/limit exceeded, duplicate, unauthorized category), severity, compliance-rule type, and remediation status. Instead, every column describes attributes of the expense or its data quality (asset type, provenance, lifecycle stage, ID completeness/quality, travel flag) which are at best external predictors or symptoms of declines, not aspects OF the decline reason. Because there are zero facets, MECE cannot be satisfied: both mutual exclusivity and exhaustiveness score 0."
}
